_comment: Batch 10E — data-driven text excluded from the prerender text diff (filled from the STAGING DB / live APIs at build time). Regions: lines strictly between `after` (searched from `from`, if given) and `until`; `routes` is a regex on the route ('/', '/msp/gehun', …). Lines: single lines matching `re` (optionally only when the previous line equals `near`). Homepage entries reuse the Batch 10D seo-diff exclusions (scripts/batch10d/seo-diff.mjs).

regions.until: बिना लॉगिन के सारी जानकारी देखें
regions.reason: crop / price / APMC of the latest mandi day

regions.until: आज की 2 मिनट की वीडियो सलाह

regions.from: आज की 2 मिनट की वीडियो सलाह

regions.reason: next melas; status depends on build date

lines.reason: date of the latest mandi day
crop and modal price of the day

lines.re: ^इस अवधि में केवल \d+ दिन का डेटा उपलब्ध$
lines.reason: number of mandi days in the DB
chart axis / point value from mandi_prices
listing age relative to the build time

head.reason: JSON-LD Dataset date range = mandi_prices min/max date

_notes: Phase 0 probe (same code e81a100, two staging builds a few hours apart): besides the entries above, /msp/* price lines (₹…) and the listing pages also change with the DB, and /articles /kisan-mela /safalta /sawaal /videos /yojana/* /info /agro-forestry were captured in a LOADING state ('थोड़ा रुकें…') in one build and complete in the other — the prerender is not deterministic for these pages. A 'removed' report on those routes must be checked by hand (re-run the build / prerender) before calling it an SEO loss.
